sources.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTA 6 Trophy List, all 55 trophies (PSNProfiles, TrueAchievements)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops automatically. It is always the last trophy you will see.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It cannot be missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 1. It unlocks when the first mission of Chapter 2 begins.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 2. It unlocks when the first mission of Chapter 3 begins.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3. It unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4. It unlocks after the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final mission of the game. It is the second gold trophy and usually pops right before the platinum.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It unlocks during the mission and cannot be missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It unlocks during the mission.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It unlocks during the mission.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It unlocks during the mission.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It unlocks during the mission.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It unlocks during the mission.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Finish the 100% Completion Checklist found under Progress, Stats, after the story. Progress made during the story already counts, and the requirements are forgiving: only 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, and 70 of 80 challenges, with most side content optional.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest to rack up. Track progress by region in the Progress menu under Activities, Stunts.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. Check the Activities list under Progress to see which types you still need.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. Use the range location guide to find every range, and pick the easiest weapon class for each challenge.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations, 42 races in total. You only need one win per location, not every race.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not count, so work through the 40 unique race locations and vary the race types.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you a fishing spot marked in purple on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to finish all levels of one game once.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest optional storyline, exclusive to Lucia in Chapter 3: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. Her quests stay available after the story.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline: clear 7 shipwrecks and bring the treasures back to his shop in Key Lento. He marks the wrecks for you in sets, and you can track them under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. He goes quiet in Chapter 2 to 3 but returns, so nothing is missable.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest optional storyline at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. It unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and stays available after the story.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands that count toward this trophy. Confirmed strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Optional questlines like Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, and Eddie do not count. Track progress in the trophy list.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver the 16 sports cars he wants to his garage in west Vice City. It unlocks after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, which also gives you the Key Cloner. Scan cars with WAiNK to check if one is on the list, and deliver them in good condition for more money.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, available as Jason after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple (Take Out Kitty Litter), then complete his second quest Spin On This to shut the labs down.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia (each spot counts twice, once per character). Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, and choose Accept. That first meditation may be required, so do not skip it.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Start Bret Vogel's hunting questline as Jason after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when he texts you about Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Hunt the unique animals he requests and bring them to him. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle on the first quest.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations across Leonida; use the card location guide to find them and finish any 3 sets.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up then R1). Any 100 count: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, and No Flusher tags are more than enough.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. You need 70 of 80 for 100% completion, so this pops naturally on the way. Check progress under Progress, Challenges.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right then Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level together, then escape the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is an easy escape route. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, with your partner called in, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level active the whole time. Wear a vest, bring sticky bombs and healing, and loot each shop properly. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, then R1 to scan). Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; you do not need to drive them. You need 200 scanned for 100% completion, so this comes naturally.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In a single use of Combat Focus (L3 plus R3 while aiming), take down 5 enemies. Buff your focus first with food, drinks, or Adrenaline, then line up 5 criminals at a gang operation and finish them fast with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It does not work on soldiers, police, or civilians.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, not one on the open airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, enter the cockpit, reverse to the runway, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station on the island in south-west Mariana County. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank in the south of the base, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, rob a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in. Find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage, and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. Start with the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, which teaches the method: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each. Robbing a vault gives an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat radius. The Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is counts as one, since the bank vault robbery starts from an armored truck. You can also block a truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door, and blow it open.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map of Leonida. Fly a plane over every fogged area until the whole map is visible.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs, 39 operations in total. They show as yellow icons when you get near them. Track each gang's count under Progress, Gangs.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. Only this specific blue Banshee counts.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation), steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You can return later for any items you missed.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out together at a fitness club (call your partner first so both train at once) or at home after the story. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, then Strength.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications so you see the demon face icon each time one counts. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes, and fights all count, and it builds up passively while you chase the other trophies.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No verified unlock method is known yet. It is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, so try the Payday Loans robberies and check back once the community confirms the trigger.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car. If it is there, follow the path into the woods to find the UFO, approach it, talk to the woman it drops, offer to help, and return to her car at the roadside. The car spawns randomly, so drive away and come back if it is not there.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No verified unlock method is known yet. It is believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, so try melee drive-by kicks from a bike and check back once the community confirms the trigger.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through a fence. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays best). The total counts across all robberies.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Guns, car mods, and tattoos are the fastest way to reach it.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related and do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and are sold through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which appears after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes), then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down.

source.name: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
